model.name: Two-layer Kubelka-Munk: finite 0.25 mm epidermis over semi-infinite dermis
model.layerComposition: Finite-layer Kubelka-Munk R/T adding equation; dermis uses the semi-infinite limit; no surface-specular term.
model.absorptionAndScattering: Donner and Jensen equations 3-8; epidermal melanin plus baseline, dermal oxy/deoxy haemoglobin plus baseline, and reduced-scattering power law.
model.colour: CIE 1931 2 degree CMFs and D65 from colour-science 0.4.7; XYZ Y normalized to 100 for a perfect reflector; CIELAB D65.

Cm.citation: Donner & Jensen 2006, EGSR, Table 1: melanin fraction typical range 0-0.5.

betaM.citation: Donner & Jensen 2006, EGSR, Figure 3 caption: beta-m fixed at 0.7 (70% eumelanin, 30% pheomelanin).

Ch.citation: Donner & Jensen 2006, EGSR, Figure 3 caption: haemoglobin fraction Ch constant at 0.5%; Table 1 typical range 0.001-0.1.

oxygenation.citation: Donner & Jensen 2006, EGSR, section 3.4 after equation 7: gamma varies about 0.6-0.8 and is fixed to 0.75 in their model.
